Name: Shed Notifications - Updated for 1.2 and  SMAPI 1.15
Author: TheCroak
Description:
[size=2]A small mod that sends you a notification when you have product ready to be collected in your greenhouse, cellar or one of your sheds, barns and/or coops!

[b]There is currently a bug where notifications don't work for crops in greenhouse, i'm working on it
[/b]
[b]Installation:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]the latest release of SMAPI[/url] (Latest update tested with SMAPI 1.15+ and SV 1.2)[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the folder the Mod folder[/size]
[*][size=2][b]If you are updating from an old installation, move ShedNotifications/config.json to BuildingsNotifications and delete the ShedNotifications folder[/b][/size]
[*][size=2]Run SMAPI[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[u]Versions+Changelog:
[/u]
[b]0.4.1 (Latest)
[/b][list]
[*][size=2][b]Removed a listener that was there for testing and spammed messages[/b][/size]
[/list]
[b]0.4 :
[/b][list]
[*][size=2]Updated for 1.2+ and SMAPI 1.15+[/size]
[/list]

[b]0.3:
[/b][list]
[*][size=2]Added Cellars[/size]
[/list]
[b]0.2:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Added Barns and Coop support.[/size]
[*][size=2]Support for each of these buildings can be toggled in the config file[/size]
[*][size=2]You can now change the times when you get notified (Default: 6:20, 12:00 and 19:00)[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[b]0.1[/b]: Initial upload, compatible with Stardew Valley 1.1
